about: Every request the client sends to the hosted service, and every field in it the service can read.

scripts/test/wire-contract.test.mjs drives each sender against a recording fetch and fails on a request, endpoint or field missing from this file, or on a field carrying data its entry does not allow.
Classes: metadata (plaintext the service can read and keep), credential (tokens and verifiers the service checks), ciphertext (encrypted bytes, nonces and wrapped keys), protocol (fixed values).

carries names what a field may hold: session_id (agent session IDs), machine_id, machine_label (the user-set name), event_id. Captured content (paths, commands, parameters, tool names) may appear in no plaintext field at all.
Adding a field: add it here with its reason, and update the public list of what the hosted service can see in the same change.

PUT /api/v1/sync/push.sender: Blob sync (the older sync path, used when segments are off or unsupported)

header:x-omnodex-sessions.why: Which sessions the blob covers, so the dashboard picks blobs

header:x-omnodex-machine-id.why: Keeps each machine's data apart for the multi-machine merge

header:x-omnodex-machine-label.why: Name in the dashboard's machine picker; sent only when the user set one
Machine picker name; sent only when the user set one

header:x-omnodex-segment-sessions.why: Number of sessions in the segment

header:x-omnodex-machine-label.why: Machine picker name; sent only when the user set one

PUT /api/v1/stream/verifier.sender: Sync and connect: register or check the stream secret's verifier

body:secret_verifier.why: Derived from the stream secret; proves a machine holds it without revealing it

GET /api/v1/stream/verifier.sender: Connect: whether the stream already has a secret

body:secret_verifier.why: Proves this machine holds the stream secret

POST /api/v1/sync/events.sender: Live push from hooks, the MCP proxy and the local dashboard

body:key_id.why: Which streaming key sealed the batch

body:events[].event_id.why: Random event ID; the relay and dashboard drop duplicates by it

body:events[].key_id.why: Which streaming key sealed the event

body:events[].ts.why: When the event was sent; the relay expires old events

POST /api/v1/ingest/events.sender: Capture from a cloud agent container (Cowork cloud tasks)

body:events[].event_id.why: Random event ID, bound to the ciphertext

body:events[].key_id.why: Which stream public key sealed the event

POST /api/v1/usage/rules.sender: Per-rule signal counts in shadow and guardrails mode

body:batch_id.why: Random ID so a resend is not counted twice

body:counts[].kind.why: Signal kind, such as would block

POST /api/v1/usage/advanced.sender: Pro rule usage counts, for billing

body:batch_id.why: Random ID so a resend is not counted twice

POST /api/v1/sync/monitoring/heartbeat.sender: Monitoring heartbeat (whether monitoring is still in place)

header:x-omnodex-machine-id.why: Which machine the heartbeat is from

body:session_open.why: Whether any agent session is open

body:offline_since.why: Start of the offline stretch, on a catch-up

body:platforms[].session_open.why: Whether a session on this platform is open

POST /api/v1/connect/claim.sender: Connection link from the CLI or the MCP proxy

body:machine_label.why: Machine picker name; sent only when the user set one

body:project_label.why: Project name the caller passed, or null

body:passphrase_enc.why: Stream secret under a one-time key that stays in the link's fragment

POST /api/v1/device/code.sender: Device code sign-in from the CLI or the MCP proxy

body:machine_label.why: Machine picker name; sent only when the user set one

body:passphrase_enc.why: Stream secret under a one-time key that stays in the link's fragment

POST /api/v1/features/submit.sender: Feature extractor transport. Nothing calls it; the test fails if anything outside its package imports it

documented_only.about: Endpoints named in source comments that the client does not call.

other_requests.about: Files that make network requests other than the endpoints above. A new file that calls fetch or https fails the test until it is listed here or its requests are covered above.
